lines.hello: Hello there! Glad you could make it.
lines.welcome: Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
lines.myName: My name is Oak. People call me the Pokémon Professor.
lines.world: This world is inhabited by creatures we call Pokémon. They live in the grass, in caves, in the sea and in the sky.
lines.oneOfThem: This is one of them. Isn't it friendly?
lines.liveAlongside: People and Pokémon live together. Some keep them as friends, and some battle alongside them.
lines.study: As for myself, I study Pokémon for a living. There is much that is still a mystery.
lines.enough: But that's enough about me. Tell me a little about yourself.
lines.boyOrGirl: Are you a boy, or are you a girl?
lines.nextDoor: And this is my grandson. The two of you have been rivals for as long as either of you can remember.
lines.neverStill: He never lets anyone get ahead of him. Now, what was his name again?
lines.ofCourse: {rival}, that's right! How could I forget?
lines.story: {name}, your very own legend is about to begin. Joy and hardship will meet you along the way.
lines.offYouGo: Now, off you go. The world of Pokémon is waiting!
